subject: Acceptance Hooks, Hard-Stop Exit Criteria & MAP Actions for PineBridge Pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@pinebridgehealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@pinebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance Hooks, Hard-Stop Exit Criteria & MAP Actions for PineBridge Pilot

Hi Samir / Laura —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I attached an updated MAP that makes the evaluation acceptance tests explicit and sets a hard-stop for the pilot go/no-go decision. High level ask: please review the Acceptance Hooks below and confirm owners for each test by EOD Monday (6/29).

Summary (short):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference at scale on PineBridge telemetry with target latency and fidelity for triage-workflow (see tests).
- Hard-stop date: 2026-07-09 — if acceptance tests fail or major blockers remain, we pause production cutover until remediation is complete.

Acceptance Hooks (must pass all to proceed):
1) Latency: p95 generation latency <= 250ms for 1K concurrent users on your test cluster (test harness attached).
2) Accuracy: prototype prompts must meet 92% pass rate on the labeled concordance set (see performance_baseline.csv).
3) Stability: no more than 1 transient GPU preemption/instance failure during 48-hour soak.
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence items A.2, A.3 (token logging, retention policy) provided and provisioned for the pilot namespace.

Acceptance test owners and quick actions (please assign):
- Latency tests: Samir / infra (run load harness + record p95) — deliver: p95 output CSV.
- Accuracy tests: Laura / ML lead (run concordance set and attach results).
- Stability soak: Marissa (CS) to run 48-hour soak; Redwood to monitor traces.
- Compliance Evidence: Hannah (security flip) + PineBridge security contact to confirm KMS and audit logs.

Contingencies & fallbacks: If latency target is missed by <20% we will: (1) apply recommended batching/quantization profile (see Redwood Optimize suggestions), (2) retest within 72 hours. If missed by >20% -> hard-stop and remediation plan required.

Attached: PineBridge_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners and test scripts), performance_baseline.csv (sample labeled set).

Next steps:
- Confirm owners by 2026-06-29 EOD.
- We will schedule a short go/no-go sync on 2026-07-08 (15 min) to review test artifacts and decide.

Thanks — looking forward to the confirmations so we can lock the cutover window.

Warmly,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: PineBridge_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: performance_baseline.csv (csv)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@pinebridgehealth.com>

Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@pinebridgehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance Hooks, Hard-Stop Exit Criteria & MAP Actions for PineBridge Pilot

Thanks Hannah — this is clear and helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we assign owners: 

1) The latency target (p95 <= 250ms) — is that measured from our edge to your model runtime (end-to-end) or only the inference time reported by Redwood? We need to know whether to include our network tail latencies in the test.

2) For the accuracy concordance set: are you expecting we run the same labeled set you supplied, or should we run an expanded sample derived from our real cases? We can do either but need to scope time.

Procurement note: our procurement team flagged that DocuSign SOW and the monthly commit need final review; procurement is likely to need 7–10 business days once legal receives the final SOW. If we confirm owners by 6/29 that likely pushes signatures into mid-July. Is the hard-stop buffer OK with that timeline?

I'll tentatively assign infra to latency testing but will confirm after the clarification on measurement.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, PineBridge Health
samir.p@pinebridgehealth.com
+1 617-555-5123

Subject: Re: Acceptance Hooks, Hard-Stop Exit Criteria & MAP Actions for PineBridge Pilot

Samir — thanks for the fast reply. Two quick clarifications: 

- Latency measurement: define end-to-end from your caller to final token emitted (so include your network tail). We will provide a small client harness to standardize measurement; please run from your staging VPC to ensure consistent pathing.

- Concordance set: start with the labeled set we provided (performance_baseline.csv) so we have a common baseline; if you want to run an expanded sample, please add the expanded results as a supplemental artifact. Acceptance is gated on the core labeled set.

Procurement & hard-stop: we designed the hard-stop date to leave a 5-business-day decision buffer prior to your expected signature window. If procurement needs additional time we can (a) move the hard-stop by mutual agreement during next week's sync or (b) run a short extension test window with stricter monitoring. Please confirm which you'd prefer.

Recommended test steps (short):
1) Run Redwood client harness from staging VPC (attached) — capture p50/p95/p99 and raw traces. Submission: p95 CSV + traces link.
2) Run concordance set (core file attached) — provide summary pass rate + sample failure cases.
3) Soak: schedule a 48-hour soak starting 2026-07-03 00:00 UTC; Redwood will stream metrics to the shared observability dashboard.

I've added a link to a short Redwood Optimize playbook that describes batching and quantization profiles we recommend if p95 misses: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4d_PineBridge_OPT.

Jordan / Marissa — can you confirm Redwood-side monitoring ownership for the soak? Jordan: you and Marissa will get the alerts; Marissa will own post-test follow-ups with PineBridge.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that helps.

Hannah
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: client_harness.zip (zip)]

Samir / Hannah —

Confirmed on Redwood monitoring ownership for the 48-hour soak. Marissa will lead the post-soak incident review and evidence collection.

On procurement: Hannah, I'll coordinate with Marissa and Legal to get the SOW into DocuSign this week; Samir, we will flag the SOW with procurement as "time-sensitive" and include a one-page summary of acceptance gates to speed review.

Quick note on escalation: if any acceptance hook fails we will document the failure mode, provide a remediation plan with target dates, and schedule a follow-up internal review within 72 hours. That will be the default path before any cancellation.
